brief:
The International Court of Justice in The Hague concluded hearings in a case brought by Nicaragua against Germany, Shehab Wire reported. Nicaragua accuses Berlin of violating its obligations under international law, particularly the Genocide Convention, in connection with Germany's ongoing support for Israel amid the conflict in Gaza.

The case examines whether Germany's partnership and military aid to Israel constitutes legal responsibility for alleged genocide in Gaza under international law. Nicaragua argues that Germany has breached its commitments as a signatory to the Genocide Convention. The court will now review the evidence and arguments presented during the hearings before issuing a ruling on the claims.
